caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical mug with a handle on the right side. The mug is rendered in varying shades of blue, with darker lines defining the outline and lighter blue hues used for shading and giving the appearance of transparency. The handle is also blue and is depicted with a curved and elongated shape, attached to the mug at the top and bottom. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. There are no other objects or elements present, and the composition centers the mug prominently in the middle of the canvas, with ample blank space surrounding it. The artist's name, "LORENZ ROTHKRANZ," is written in small text at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Mug
